title: Lua
notes: Parser, scanner, private headers and bundled queries use the pinned upstream revision, with listed local adaptations. Existing public API and useful indentation configuration retained.
Native fixtures check syntax, captures and supported predicates; they do not certify all syntax, incremental editing or Swift theme rendering.
source:
-- Attributes, long strings, methods and builtins
local LIMIT <const> = 42
local message = [=[hello]=]
local object = {}
function object:compute(value)
 print(message)
 return value + LIMIT
end
object:compute(1)
injection_source:
ffi.cdef[[int add(int a, int b);]]
print[[ordinary text]]
query_adaptations: Give contextual function captures .call/.definition subscopes so generic variable/property captures do not override function styling at the same range.
Switch parser, scanner and queries coherently to canonical tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua.
Clear per-instance scanner payload before deserialize, including length0 reset; tested with independent scanner/parser instances and reset/reuse.
Normalize upstream legacy repeat/conditional/field/parameter/method/preproc and boolean captures to Runestone scopes; convert any-of? builtin list to equivalent anchored regex.
Use c injection for ffi.cdef string contents and preserve exact cdef predicate.
scanner_adaptations: Reset payload before deserializing initial/short state; see lua_scanner_state.c.
